contradictions.value_a: Injected ZOM-567 to ZOM-663 are created 2025-09-25 07:05:12Z to 07:18:47Z.
contradictions.value_b: Base ZOM-565 is created 2025-09-25T13:46:04Z and base ZOM-566 2025-09-30T16:26:02Z, i.e. two lower numbers were created after 97 higher ones (ZOM-566 five days after).
